name: ĐấuLa ĐạiLục: Thế Giới Săn Hồn

detail.description:
Officially adapted from both the anime and novel, the first 3D open-world MMORPG of the Douluo IP has officially launched on all platforms! It's time to shake up the Douluo Continent and set a new standard for Douluo game quality!

The moment of awakening has arrived. Welcome to the Douluo Continent! When the first spark of Soul Power awakens within you, you will step into the heart of the storm, becoming your own legend.
